purpose: Discover and split 女X entities across the 508GB corpus while separating deity/person, ritual person, genealogy, place, grammar, reading variants, state/people, and unresolved nodes before any cultural-family or sex inference.
epistemic_rule: Exact strings are retrieval seeds only. 女+core graph is cross-tradition; 女 may participate in sex/class/clan/title or reading/transmission structures, and cannot by itself establish sex, Wa/frog affiliation, or historical identity.

textual_relations.guard: Do not count as independent deities unless independent witness evidence survives collation.
佩文韵府 preserves 女蔑 while earlier Guo Pu-line text preserves 女薎; compare witnesses rather than count two gods.
Two distinct 女歧 occurrences in 天问 remain separate occurrence nodes until identity is tested.
左传传本 has 女艾 and 经典释文 says 女如字又音汝; 竹书纪年 tradition has 汝艾. This relation does not establish sex.

A reported scholarly proposal merges them by event role plus phonological argument; Su Xuelin explicitly rejects it. Preserve separate occurrence nodes until witness, phonology, and event details converge.
Same surface name in 天问 is not enough to merge a nine-child divine occurrence with the Shaokang-Hanjiao occurrence.
Historical spelling is 女媊; later transmission explicitly glosses 媊音前.
Textual-critical duplicate hypothesis is not raw-source identity fact.

cultural_family_guard: Wa/frog membership requires an independent evidence bundle such as western geography + water/rain/Chishui + frog/Wa phonology/iconography/ritual/genealogy. 女X form alone has zero positive weight. 女艾/汝艾 further proves that the surface graph 女 can participate in a reading/transmission variant, while 秦本纪索隐 independently proves maternal-clan genealogy; these facts must be tested separately rather than collapsed into one universal 女-prefix rule.
